title: General-Purpose Robot Skill Composer — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Combines reusable movement and manipulation skills into plans for unfamiliar tasks. A proposed composer that builds robot behavior from reusable skills: given an unfamiliar task, it selects movement and manipulation primitives from a library, sequences and blends them into a plan, and verifies the plan in simulation before the robot moves. New tasks become new compositions, not new programming.
capabilities: Select reusable skills matching task requirements
Sequence and blend skills into coherent plans
Verify plans in simulation before execution
Adapt compositions to different robot bodies
Learn new composite skills from successful plans
